title: Upload session
description: 201 from POST /v1/blobs/uploads: the Blob is not stored yet. Chunks are numbered from 0; chunk i holds bytes [i*chunk_size, min((i+1)*chunk_size, size)), so there are ceil(size/chunk_size) of them and an empty Blob has none (E19). PUT them in any order, then finalize. Open.

chunk_size.description: Bytes per chunk, fixed for the session; resuming returns the same value.

received.description: Indexes of the chunks the Hub already holds, so a resumed upload sends only the rest.
